recording.method: Actual live Chrome UI, recorded from its X display with FFmpeg x11grab. Both WebRTC viewers, mouse-operated controls and T-bar are captured together; no offline UI reconstruction or substituted viewer pictures.
sequence: Manual fade to 50 percent, hold and complete

scope: Documentation screen recording on a shared host. Browser presentation dropped frames during this capture; the 30 fps screen recording does not assert 30 unique presented frames per viewer per second. This does not replace historical capacity or latency benchmarks.
